stats_help: Resolution describes decoded video; quality describes the selected stream. Bitrate and FPS are stream metadata. Download speed estimates the last segment transfer, not your internet capacity. Buffer measures playable media ahead, excluding gaps. Graphs show the last 60 seconds while visible. Buffering counters cover enabled, visible observation only; seeking, pauses and initial loading are excluded. Network and frame counters belong to the current media source.
